cases.reason: The rule governs every direct or indirect reference to a based item while its address is NULL. In 2002 that includes identifier-1 of the communication facility's SEND cd-name FROM identifier-1 (A.2.6, any alphanumeric data item) and RECEIVE cd-name INTO identifier-1 (A.2.5): a based PIC X item is a legal operand of both. Those statement forms do not exist in 2023 (its SEND/RECEIVE are the message-server statements, another format), so the 2023 row's CONFORMS verdict and its witnesses (DISPLAY, MOVE) say nothing about them. The compiler claims the 2002 communication facility (it compiles and runs the probes, with obsolete-element warning COBOL0903), so this is a claimed 2002 scope item. Placement (§2002:13.14.2 SR15) and the Fatal table entry are the same, so the communication-statement operand is the only gap. Not a cd-name operand: the operand is the message area of a communication statement. Probes at --std 2002: SEND OUT-CD FROM B WITH EMI and RECEIVE IN-CD MESSAGE INTO B, B BASED and NULL, each print HANDLED=EC-DATA-PTR-NULL and continue after RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT: correct. Needs: a 2002 witness for a NULL based item as a SEND FROM / RECEIVE INTO operand (the probes can be adopted).
